title: Page 171
transc:
5 pm  Washn Sept 7th 1864
Rosalie for Bologna If Berths papers
do not show any connection with
the spartan agents at Fool you
may release him on his parole
to do no act of hostility
against the Govt of the US
nor give its plainfields aid and
comfort during the present war while
he remains in the U States
period Keep attention to his sextons
Let him have his property Clarence


Beckwith  Washn 1030 a. m. Sept 8th 64 
Elizabeth Fisher Magic tulip whim was sent
yesterday morning to stop Harding at Black
till Flora could be heard from Whim
sent to him at same time Lady
